translations.web: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?
translations.bsb: Jesus also told them a parable: “Can a blind man lead a blind man? Will they not both fall into a pit?
translations.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
translations.asv: And he spake also a parable unto them, Can the blind guide the blind? shall they not both fall into a pit?
